# Materials — Authorized offensive security and red team / Rapid course / English

[Edition overview](README.md) · [Chapters](SUBJECTS.md) · [One principal book plan](book/PLAN.md) · [Supplementary playbooks](../../../../playbooks/offensive-security-red-team/README.md) · [Course skill](../skill/SKILL.md)

**Teaching and examples:** each subject-chapter belongs to the one principal book. Plans describe intended content; only the linked manuscript contains authored lessons.

**Labs and practice:** the published English manuscript contains two offline labs. Do not edit the scripts. The scope print stays:

```text
192.0.2.5      in scope
192.0.2.10     EXCLUDED - do not test
192.0.2.130    OUT OF SCOPE - do not test
198.51.100.7   OUT OF SCOPE - do not test
```

The ranking print stays:

```text
F1 score=6 high   Staff portal allows reused passwords
F3 score=6 high   Shared admin account on grading system
F4 score=4 medium Guest Wi-Fi reaches printer admin page
F2 score=2 low    Old web server banner shows version
```

Use synthetic data only. Do not replace either print. The scripts send no traffic and contain no exploit code. `192.0.2.10` is excluded even though it sits in `192.0.2.0/25`. F4 at score 4 is the embedded line. An impact of 3 is not that line.

**Projects and assessment:** score the authored exercises with their 0–3 rubrics. Review of the edition is still open. Page count is not the writing target.

**Exercises and answers:** EX001–EX066 have worked results in the final appendix of the same book. The exercise baseline in the chapter index is a planning aid, not a quota.

**References and glossary:** verifiable primary sources and clear terms belong in the authored manuscript; linked project playbooks retain their source rights.
